purpose: Teach: 通告/知らさ/運送/日報/年内/償却/用地/代わる

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 取引先からの通告、内容、確認しろ。
lines.en: Verify the details of the notice from our trading partner.
lines.style: Clipped, direct authority. Minimal breath. Each word lands as an instruction, not a request. No wasted syllables. Eyes level, jaw set.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。重要な案件は、社員一同、知らされております。
lines.en: Understood. The entire staff has been informed of the important matters.
lines.style: Respectful, steady. Slight emphasis on 「一同」 to show completeness and readiness. Posture attentive. Not defensive — just reporting what's already in motion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 運送会社との契約、来月、見直す。
lines.en: We're reviewing the shipping company contract next month.
lines.style: Measured, decisive. Slight pause before 「来月」. Tempo steady as a clock. This is policy being stated, not negotiated. Forward-facing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。日報、毎日、丁寧に、書かせております。
lines.en: Yes. I'm making sure the daily reports are being filled out carefully every day.
lines.style: Attentive, showing initiative without overstepping. Light emphasis on 「丁寧に」 — care in the details. Tone says: the groundwork is solid.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プロジェクト、年内に、完了を目指せ。
lines.en: Aim to have the project completed by year-end.
lines.style: Sharp, final. Weight on 「年内に」. Not a question of if, but when. The kind of instruction that settles into the room and doesn't move.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。設備の償却年数、見直しております。
lines.en: Yes. We're reviewing the equipment depreciation schedule.
lines.style: Composed, methodical. Steady breathing. Shows he's already thinking ahead and tracking multiple threads. No anxiety — just competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新工場の用地、東京近郊で、調査しろ。
lines.en: Survey potential sites for the new factory in the Tokyo area.
lines.style: Brisk, forward momentum. Weight on 「調査しろ」. This is expansion — no hesitation in his voice. Eyes already past this moment to the next phase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会議に、私が代わる形で、出席することも、できます。
lines.en: Understood. I'm also available to attend meetings in your place if needed.
lines.style: Respectful but assured. Light emphasis on 「代わる形で」 — offering without presumption. Quietly volunteering readiness without seeking credit. Still professional, still in posture.
